topic: Dollar-cost averaging into an index fund beats most people who try to pick individual winning stocks
title: Why 85% of Stock Pickers Fail to Beat the Market
description:
Most people who try to pick winning stocks fail to beat the market average. A simple, consistent strategy called dollar-cost averaging historically outperforms the vast majority of active traders. Here's the math.
